method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (ica-core.l4) with one regulative rule (s 50J(7)(a), the order to identify associated trusts within 28 days or the period the court sets) run by EVALTRACE inside a function that takes only plain facts; one seat layer (the person abused as a child) that restates no rule; answers are named outcomes, lists of them, or dates; MAYBE BOOLEAN only in two internal s 50V helpers, never in an exported answer, so no NOTHING-kind tags; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Civil Liability Act 1936 (SA), Parts 7A and 7B (ss 50A-50X, inserted by the Civil Liability (Institutional Child Abuse Liability) Amendment Act 2021, in operation 1 August 2022), from the Open Australian Legal Corpus (South Australian legislation last collected 2025-03-10), corpus document south_australian_legislation:2023-06-22/1936.2267.un, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/civil-liability-act-1936.txt; not the official text, possibly out of date. The commencement of s 3A of the Limitation of Actions Act 1936 (1 February 2019) is taken from that Act's deposited legislative history. No regulation made under Part 7A is deposited.

seat: the person abused as a child who brings or may bring a claim against an institution, or that person's representative (ica-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run ica-dates.l4 ; l4 run ica-core.l4 ; l4 run ica-seat.l4 ; l4 run ica-cases.l4
checks.result: 131 assertions written, 131 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a negative control (s 50J(6)(a) 120 days to 119, s 50J(7)(a) 28 days to 29, the commencement of Part 7A 1 to 2 August 2022) failed exactly the 11 predicted assertions and was reverted
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: Part 7A Division 1 (ss 50A(1), (2), 50B, 50C, 50D(1)), Division 2 (ss 50E, 50F), Division 3 (s 50G), Division 4 (ss 50H, 50I, 50J(1)-(3), (5)-(7)(a), 50K), Division 5 (ss 50L, 50M, 50N, 50O(4), 50P), Division 6 (ss 50R(1)-(6)(a), 50S(3), 50U); Part 7B (ss 50V, 50W, 50X). Out: what the regulations prescribe (ss 50A(3), 50C(1)(e), 50F(3)(i), 50J(3)), s 50J(4), (7)(b), ss 50O(1)-(3), (5), 50Q, 50R(6)(b)-(g), 50T. The Limitation of Actions Act 1936 s 3A half of South Australia's child abuse reforms is encoded in subjects/au/sa/limitation-of-actions-act-1936/encodings/baseline-2026-11/. Reasons in NOTES.md.
